open_points.subject: A04-3 and A04-6 timestamp guarantees
open_points.text:
a correction that
   changes a Customer, and a mark that restricts it, each move the Customer's
   revision by exactly one; a correction of either that changes nothing
   leaves the revision, and the project's last-changed instant, where they
   were.
open_points.question: What Required test must show that a changed Customer's last-changed instant moves to the current instant and that an unchanged Customer's last-changed instant stays unchanged, as required by the revision/instant pair received from State 1?
options: Extend this item to assert both Customer timestamp outcomes
Add a separate Required tests item for the Customer timestamp outcomes
open_points.default_guess: Extend this item to check the Customer revision and last-changed instant together.

witness.initial: A Customer has revision 3 and last-changed instant T1.
events: The owner corrects the Customer at T2.
The owner then submits an equal correction at T3.
outcomes: An implementation moves the timestamp to T2 and leaves it there after the no-op.
An implementation moves only the revision, or moves the timestamp again at T3, while still satisfying the test as written.
witness.observer: The owner reading the Customer and the Factory check

open_points.subject: non-Kernel token supplying agent-session authority
open_points.text:
Each service other than Cabinet Kernel calling 'request access to a
   project' or 'read the agent projection', with a registered session's id in
   the session header, is refused and the session is unchanged.
open_points.question: For an operation also present in another service's ordinary rights row, what happens when that non-Kernel service supplies a session header: is the header ignored and the ordinary service call checked, or is the call refused as an attempt to use agent authority?
options: Any non-Kernel call carrying the agent-session header is refused
The header is ignored for non-Kernel services and their ordinary operation rights apply
Only operations declared exclusively agent-authority are refused; overlapping operations remain ordinary calls
open_points.default_guess: Refuse any non-Kernel call that supplies the agent-session header.

witness.initial: Client Portal has a valid token, and a registered Kernel session is granted project P.
events: Client Portal calls 'list artifacts' for P and supplies that session's id in the session header.
outcomes: The call is refused because only Kernel may invoke agent authority.
The call is answered under Client Portal's ordinary 'list artifacts' right, ignoring the session header.

open_points.subject: stale-version coverage for every owner session action
open_points.text:
each of the owner's
   actions stating the version before it is refused and changes nothing.
open_points.question: What exact history must the check repeat for each owner action: must it first perform that action successfully and then retry with the pre-change version, or may any earlier version-moving action create the stale version used to test it?
options: For every owner-action kind, accept that action and then retry it with its pre-change version
Move the version by any action, then exercise every owner-action kind with the stale version
Specify separate histories where an action's legal preconditions differ after its first execution
open_points.default_guess: Use a preceding version-moving change and then test every owner-action kind with the stale version, choosing a state in which that action would otherwise be valid.

set_aside.subject: project correction instants
set_aside.text:
The facts a correction does not edit — identity, status, marks, instants,
   request id — are not part of it and do not change by it.
set_aside.question: Must “instants” exclude the last-changed instant, which A04 requires a changing correction to replace with the current instant?
options: Only created and other written-once instants remain unchanged; last-changed moves
Every instant, including last-changed, remains unchanged
set_aside.default_guess: Exclude last-changed from A03's unchanged instants and let A04 move it.
